evidence: Created "QA Test Gadget" via /admin Add Product form (Tech category), edited it to "QA Test Gadget Edited" changing category to Home Goods; created second minimal product "QA Test Gadget 2" (Tech). Create/edit works across categories.

Set Featured=true on QA Test Gadget Edited via edit form. Existing featured products (Peloton Bike+, Dyson V15 Detect, Sony WH-1000XM5) display "Featured" badge on product cards in /products list and homepage carousel.
Searching "wireless" (a tag not present in Sony WH-1000XM5's visible name/short description) correctly matched and returned that product, confirming search spans name, description, and tags.
Added tags "qa, testing, gadget, updated-tag" to existing product via edit form; tags appeared on detail page and became available in Filters panel tag pills.
Free-text comma-separated Tags field allows creating new labels (e.g. "updated-tag") not previously in the system; new tag appeared as a filterable pill in Filters panel.
Edited existing tags on QA Test Gadget (changed/added values via edit form Tags field); updated tags correctly reflected on product detail page and filter pills.
Changed QA Test Gadget Edited's category assignment from Tech Gadgets to Home Goods via edit form combobox; change correctly reflected in admin list, /products list, and detail page category badge.
Selecting "Fitness" category filter on /products instantly returned exactly the 3 correctly-categorized Fitness products (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton), excluding all Tech/Home items.
/products lists all products as cards showing image, category badge, price, name, short description, star rating value, and a "Buy Now" purchase link for each item.

Minimum Rating filter "4.5+ stars" correctly reduced 10→9 products, excluding only Philips Hue Starter Kit (4.4). Price Range minimum slider raised to $120 correctly reduced 10→9 products, excluding only QA Test Gadget 2 ($0); all remaining listed prices ($199-$2495) were ≥$120.

Category combobox in product create/edit form and filter offers exactly 3 fixed options: Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness (plus "All Categories" in filter context). No free-text entry or ability to add a new category.
Category filter (Fitness), rating filter (4.5+), and price minimum ($120) each returned result sets whose members strictly satisfied the given criteria with no extraneous items included.

Category, rating, and price-slider filter changes updated the product count and list immediately without a page reload or explicit submit action (verified via accessibility snapshots taken right after each interaction).

Clicking a product card/link navigated directly to its /product/[slug] detail page via in-app SPA routing without a full page reload, confirmed by client-side state (newly created products) persisting across the navigation.

Verified via browser_evaluate that the "Buy Now" anchor has target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer", and href matching the entered affiliate link (e.g. https://example.com/buy/qa-test-gadget), confirming correct safe external link behavior.
Product detail page (e.g. QA Test Gadget Edited) fully displays category badge, rating, name, description, price, Buy Now button, Tags list, Key Specifications, and full "My Review" text.

After editing category (Tech→Home Goods) and tags, the product was correctly and consistently re-categorized/tagged everywhere (admin list, /products list, /category pages, detail page) with no mislabeling observed.
Edited values (price $149, tags, spec Weight 1.2kg, category Home Goods) appeared identically and without truncation across admin list, /products list, and the product detail page.
